name: v2.23.0
body:
## What's Changed
* Add `--pull=always` to documented `docker run` command by @rolandwalker in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2224
* Include MariaDB server and data in Docker image by @rolandwalker in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2225
* Tokenize a leading slash or backslash as a symbol name by @rolandwalker in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2226
* Prepare changelog for release v2.23.0 by @rolandwalker in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2227


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/compare/v2.22.0...v2.23.0
